mechanism: Timolol (beta-blocker) may antagonize the vasodilatory and hypotensive effects of minoxidil, reducing its efficacy for hair growth, while systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol could potentiate hypotensive effects if minoxidil is systemically absorbed.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive or topical minoxidil formulation; assess efficacy of minoxidil therapy and counsel patient on proper application techniques to minimize systemic absorption.
